parameters.name: AlertLevels
parameters.description: The list of alert notification levels.

parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number of the current page in a paging query.

parameters.name: EndTime
parameters.description: The timestamp of the end time.

parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description: The ID of the asset instance.

parameters.name: InstanceName
parameters.description: The name of the server to query.

parameters.name: InternetIp
parameters.description: The public IP address of the asset to query.

parameters.name: IntranetIp
parameters.description: The private IP address of the asset to query.

parameters.name: Operation
parameters.description:
The type of operation performed on the file. Valid values:

- **DELETE**: deletes the file.
- **WRITE**: writes to the file.
- **READ**: reads the file.
- **RENAME**: renames the file.
- **CHOWN**: changes the file owner and associated group.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries to return on each page in a paging query.

parameters.name: StartTime
parameters.description: The timestamp of the start time.

parameters.name: Status
parameters.description:
The event status. Valid values:

- 0: Unhandled. 
- 1: Manually handled.
- 2: Whitelisted.
- 3: Ignored.

parameters.name: Uuid
parameters.description:
The UUID of the server to query.
>You can call the [DescribeCloudCenterInstances](~~DescribeCloudCenterInstances~~) operation to obtain this parameter.
